status: Proposed and untested; examples.json does not execute this market-data protocol
level: One immutable long-reference L per day, published strictly before09:35; retain point-in-time source/version evidence. Missing evidence excludes a day with its reason counted.
arming: 09:35 open, only if09:34 completed close > L, all prior inputs available; one opportunity per day, no reentry or scaling
order_expiry: 09:40 open; no new signal after09:39 close
passive: One-unit buy limit L working09:35 until09:40; examine touch-fill and penetration-required(low<=L-0.25) assumptions separately, neither certifies real queue fill
confirmation: During09:35..09:39, observe a low<=L-0.25 then same-or-later completed close>=L+0.25. Queue one next-minute-open buy before09:45. Cancel new confirmation entry unless L-4 < next open < L+4. No before-close entry.
fixed_stop: L-4 points for both arms; no later tightening
fixed_target: L+4 points for both arms; common absolute level, so remaining reward/risk differ with entry
intrabar_ambiguity: If a source bar cannot order entry/stop/target or a first fill gaps through invalidation, retain unresolved status and adverse/favorable bounds where supported. Never assume a winning order. Need finer trade/order evidence to resolve.
gap_existing_position: For an existing long stop gap, model observed open below stop with stated extra cost; this is a paper assumption, not an exchange fill guarantee
remainder_at_cutoff: One simulated liquidation at09:45 observed open for remaining filled position; real protected-order nonfills not recreated
approach: Freeze at09:34 completed close, before arming; never cancel a past fill using touch-bar close or future low
speed: max(0,close[t-5]-close[t])/ATR9[t] over five one-minute changes; ATR Wilder-seeded from first nine TRs, TR=max(high-low,abs(high-prior observed close),abs(low-prior observed close)); first TR=high-low; recurrence(8*priorATR+TR)/9
speed_buckets: below1.5 versus at least1.5; descriptive strata for both arms, not a proved cancellation policy
efficiency: abs(close[t]-close[t-5])/sum(abs(close[i]-close[i-1]),i=t-4..t); unavailable if zero denominator; separately below0.8 versus at least0.8
denominators: All eligible armed days for mean per opportunity and paired difference; actual filled trades for mean per fill/win rate; no fill has zero trading P&L but remains in opportunity denominator. Unresolved is not no fill and is not assigned zero.
data: Licensed point-in-time levels and trade/quote/order evidence where queue or ordering matters; minute OHLC alone cannot supply actual queue position. Record exact dates, contracts, gaps, exclusions, latency, costs and every variant. Do not merge future-filled versus unfilled statuses.
short_side: Not specified or tested; needs its own mirrored protocol and evidence
parameter_status: Clock times, offsets and thresholds chosen to make the proposed comparison concrete; not estimated, optimized, proven or trading recommendations
